preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The input n is an integer.

postconditions.description: The output sequence contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in result_seq)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output sequence is an integer between 1 and n.
The output sequence is the lexicographically maximum result, which consists of n-1 ones followed by n (for n > 1), or just [1] for n=1.
